mapper.select: SELECT * FROM questions WHERE category = #{category} AND difficulty = #{difficulty}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO questions(type, content, category, difficulty, score, option_a, option_b, option_c, option_d, correct_answer, `explain`, created_at, updated_at) VALUES(#{type}, #{content}, #{category}, #{difficulty}, #{score}, #{optionA}, #{optionB}, #{optionC}, #{optionD}, #{correctAnswer}, #{explain}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE questions SET type = #{type}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, score = #{score}, option_a = #{optionA}, option_b = #{optionB}, option_c = #{optionC}, option_d = #{optionD}, correct_answer = #{correctAnswer}, `explain` = #{explain}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
